name: time-off-core
title: Time off core
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Business days excluding weekends and a configurable holiday calendar, plus the balance that would remain.

meta.descriptionEs: Días de ausencia sin fines de semana ni festivos, y el saldo que quedaría. El calendario de México es reemplazable.

examples.title: Una semana de septiembre
examples.description: Del 14 al 18 de septiembre de 2026, el 16 no cuenta.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Rango vacío, fecha inválida y diez años.

meta.usage:
businessSpan(start, end, holidays)
requestedUnits(start, end, holidays, "half")
balanceLeft(available, pending, requested)

api.name: businessSpan
api.description: Inclusive ISO dates. Weekends and matching holidays are skipped.

api.name: requestedUnits
api.description: day uses the span. half is 0.5 only when the start date is a business day.

api.name: balanceLeft
api.description: Can be negative when the request does not fit.

api.name: mexicoStatutoryHolidays
api.description: LFT article 74. 1 December is included every sixth year. Election days are extra.

docs: Pure helpers. The Mexico list follows LFT article 74 and the host can replace it. github.com/kargulstudio/calender-app-design (MIT) was a behavior reference only; no source was copied.
